entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker from Zendikar searching for a weapon against the Eldrazi, who arrives on Theros, summons a leviathan, and lets tritons mistake her for a god's emissary.

entities.name: Kalemnos
entities.description: A handsome triton who speaks for his fellows, doubts Kiora is Thassa, and agrees to help her as her follower.

entities.name: Tritons
entities.description: Crested merfolk of the Siren Sea who serve Thassa and are frightened by the Silence.

entities.name: Leviathan
entities.description: A vast leviathan from another world that Kiora summons and rides.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The god of the sea, whom the tritons serve and mistakenly think Kiora to be.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: The eldest god, whose speaking led the gods to retreat into Nyx in the Silence.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: A god whose pet hydra was slain by the Sun's Champion.

entities.name: Sun's Champion
entities.description: A human who slew Nylea's pet hydra, bringing about the Silence.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrosities that Kiora needs a weapon to fight on Zendikar.

entities.name: Krakens
entities.description: Fearsome sea monsters that can lay waste to land and sea and that seemingly only the gods command.

entities.name: The Silence
entities.description: The absence of the gods after Kruphix spoke and they retreated into Nyx.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night-sky realm into which the gods retreated.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between worlds that Kiora swims through.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Kiora's wild home world, which she compares to a shark.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The mortal world where Kiora arrives.

entities.name: Siren Sea
entities.description: The sea near Meletis where Kiora arrives.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A human polis near where Kiora arrives.

events.summary: Kiora, unable to return to Zendikar without a weapon against the Eldrazi, continues her search and planeswalks through the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Not without a weapon to fight the monstrosities called the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Kiora arrives in a new ocean and tastes a new world.
events.quote: Kiora swam, and tasted a new world.

events.summary: Kiora casts a massive upwelling spell to draw out the titans of the deep, sending a wave toward shore, but nothing answers.
events.quote: Immense and sluggish currents flowed together directly below her

events.summary: Kiora summons a leviathan from another world and rides it toward shore.
events.quote: The leviathan rose beneath her and she clung to its spines.

events.summary: Kiora meets native tritons and learns she is on Theros near Meletis, where they take her for Thassa.
events.quote: "You are on Theros ," he said. "You are in the mortal world."

events.summary: The tritons explain the Silence, saying the gods retreated into Nyx after Kruphix spoke and blaming the Sun's Champion for slaying Nylea's hydra.
events.quote: The Sun's Champion slew Nylea's pet hydra.

events.summary: Kiora lets the tritons believe she is a god and privately questions Kalemnos about whether he believes she is Thassa.
events.quote: "And do you believe I am Thassa?"

events.summary: Kalemnos guesses Kiora is Thassa's emissary and agrees to help her find the sea's mightiest children.
events.quote: I believe you may be her emissary, sent to guide us while she is absent.

events.summary: Kiora declares a quest from Thassa and leads the tritons out to the open sea on the leviathan to hunt krakens.
events.quote: "Then consider this a quest from Thassa," said Kiora.

relations.note: She seeks a weapon to fight them.
relations.quote: Not without a weapon to fight the monstrosities called the Eldrazi.

relations.note: He agrees to help her as her follower.
relations.quote: "I would like nothing better," he said.

relations.note: They say they are ever in her service.
relations.quote: We tritons are ever in your service.
A vast dark body took shape beneath her, a leviathan from another world.
The Sun's Champion slew Nylea's pet hydra.
